record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace each fixed 0.5 residual multiplier with a jointly trained scalar sigmoid gate initialized to 0.5. This starts with the incumbent residual behavior while allowing each causal block to learn its update strength, rather than imposing the previously regressing depth schedule. Retain both causal convolutions, dilation schedule, features, embeddings, sequence readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Save the gates within each category's single model checkpoint and update architecture metadata and predictor loading.

category_rationales.rationale: Learn one scalar sigmoid residual gate per causal block, initialized to 0.5 to preserve the incumbent starting behavior. All four category models retain their causal convolutions, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Gates are jointly trained and saved in each model's single checkpoint; predictor metadata checks identify the updated architecture.
